assets.name: banner-750x400.jpg
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Draw ONE landscape, full-bleed illustration for a WeChat sticker album detail-page banner at 750 × 400 (15:8), no layout or panels. Reference images 1 and 2 are the SAME established character from this sticker album: use their likeness, hair shape and colors, ornament placement, costume, face and thick organic dark doodle outlines faithfully. Kimi: long white hair with faint lavender-blue tips, periwinkle eyes, single gold crescent moon over navy-and-white ribbon on viewer's right temple with hanging little gold star, navy blue and white ruffled dress, navy collar bow, small gold square book at waist. No horns, no animal ears. Match the lively hand-inked little chibi with broad opaque color blocks and a few crayon highlights in the references. No typography, readable letters, numbers, signatures or watermark anywhere. Scene: At a cheerful late-afternoon window seat she has cupped a glowing golden firefly; now it lifts free from her open hands and she leans forward smiling. A melon-peach sky behind a rich blue-violet window frame, leafy silhouettes and a single warm lamp create a luminous summer evening. Make the central firefly easy to see, with a short curved golden flight trail; no field of glitter. Frame the single character large enough to recognize, with face, main prop and action fully inside the central 85% of the picture. Let background shapes fill all four sides. Give the image a rich colored opaque ground. Keep proportions natural, uncluttered silhouettes, one coherent moment, no white margin and no text.
assets.process: Proportional center crop to 750 × 400; JPEG quality 91, 4:4:4.

Pose: face front, smiling gently, hands folded lightly at her chest under the navy collar bow, white sleeves and navy bodice visible, moon clip and dangling gold star visible. Reference images 1 and 2 are the SAME established character from this sticker album: use their likeness, hair shape and colors, ornament placement, costume, face and thick organic dark doodle outlines faithfully. No typography, readable letters, numbers, signatures or watermark anywhere. Draw only the character's HEAD from straight in front: open periwinkle eyes with an inquisitive smile, large identifiable gold crescent pinned to a simplified navy bow on viewer's right; face framed by white fringe.
